disposition: The DEEPBOM export remains a valid root-only CycloneDX 1.7 BOM. Consumers that inspect only components[] omit the BOM root and are not compatible with this fixture; the root is not duplicated to accommodate that behavior.
interpretation_boundary: This record verifies one hash-identified DEEPBOM fixture and the component-discovery contract. It does not claim compatibility with every third-party CycloneDX consumer or version.
